note: Daviess County IN publishes its zoning only through its WTH-hosted county GIS viewer (daviessin.wthgis.com) and a zoning map PDF (daviess.org QuickLinks). No queryable ArcGIS REST zoning districts layer was found: wthgis REST paths return 404, the county ArcGIS host does not respond, and the Schneider and Indiana state services carry no Daviess zoning. The Owensboro (iompc) zoning services are for Daviess County, Kentucky, not Indiana. Regrid zoning is paid and third-party.
